summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Board approved the appointment of Ms. Huang Lilan as Chief Accounting Officer effective November 2, 2026. The filing is a routine, planned executive appointment rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO/board departure, so it does not qualify as a special situation. Ms. Huang, 44, previously served as Vice President and Financial Director at Solai Limited and as CFO of Loto Interactive Limited, and will oversee global finance and accounting, budgeting, forecasting and tax. No deal terms, advisors or board recommendations are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
